name: Lizard

modes.label: Sandbox (Small / Medium / Large, flat per second while it runs)
modes.note: Limits page Sizes table (checked 2026-10-14): "Small | 2 vCPU / 4 GB | 5 GB | $0.0162 per hour", "Medium (default) | 4 vCPU / 8 GB | 20 GB | $0.0324 per hour", "Large | 8 vCPU / 16 GB | 50 GB | $0.0648 per hour"; "CPU and memory are included in the price. Persistent Volumes are billed separately." (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/limits.md). The size is chosen at create time (`size` is 'small', 'medium', or 'large', https://lizard.build/docs/sandboxes/sdk-reference.md). "Each size has a flat hourly price, billed by the second while the sandbox runs, idle time included." and "A paused sandbox is not billed" (https://lizard.build/docs/sandboxes.md). Disk is the per-size `/workspace` disk; its files are lost on stop unless a Persistent Volume is attached. A restore runs at its source's size and price; one restored from a pod snapshot is billed by measured usage. The flat rates are about a sixth of Lizard's own per-resource rates ($0.000006948 per vCPU-s, $0.000003474 per GB-s, i.e. ~$0.10/h for 2 vCPU / 4 GB).

plans.name: Pro trial
plans.note: "Pro starts with a 7-day trial and $5 in trial credits. You add a card to start it" (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/billing.md). Limits until the first paid invoice: "Pro trial | 5 | 6 | 30 | 100" (running at once, starts per minute / hour / day, https://lizard.build/docs/platform/limits.md). When the trial credits run out, running resources pause; unused trial credits end with the trial. Converts to Pro at $19 unless cancelled.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: "Lizard has one self-serve plan, Pro. It costs $19 a month and comes with $19 in monthly credits." "Unused monthly credits do not carry over to the next month." Usage above the credits is pay as you go at the same rates, charged in steps ($20, $100, $200, $400, $1,000); "There is no spending cap." No seat fees. Credits are shared with apps, databases, storage and egress across the platform (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/billing.md). Limits from the first paid invoice: "Pro | 100 | 24 | 120 | 400" (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/limits.md). Sandbox egress past 2 TB per rolling 30 days is not charged; the account's sandboxes lose outbound network instead.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: "Enterprise accounts pay as you go and get an invoice each month for the month before. Rates, limits and payment terms follow your contract." (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/billing.md). Pricing page: custom limits, signed DPA and security review, "SOC 2 report (coming soon)", SSO / SAML, RBAC & audit log, dedicated nodes on demand; no HIPAA listed.

extras.price: $0.000000054 per GB-s (~$0.14/GB-month), billed on used space while you keep the data; 1-50 GB, node-local storage

isolation.quote: Each sandbox is a Firecracker microVM with its own kernel.
isolation.note: Exception: "A sandbox that attaches a pod-backed Persistent Volume, or restores a pod snapshot, runs as a Kubernetes pod with the runc runtime and shares the host kernel." `getInfo().runtime` tells which.

ssh.quote: `lizard sandbox ssh` opens an interactive shell with your CLI credentials. SSH protocol access is not available, so SSH clients, `scp`, and port forwarding do not work.

pause_resume.quote: `pause()` saves the sandbox's memory and running processes, keeps `/workspace` on its node, and stops billing. `resume()` restores the sandbox with the same ID.
pause_resume.note: Pausing closes open network connections; a paused sandbox resumes on the same node and its state is lost if that node fails. Paused sandboxes do not count toward the running limit.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: `sandbox.snapshot(name, { poolSize })` | `sandbox.snapshot(name, pool_size=...)` | Save memory and `/workspace` files as a private snapshot.
snapshot_on_demand.note: Attached Persistent Volumes are not captured. A Firecracker snapshot restores from disk at its source's size and price; a pod snapshot keeps 1-10 warm copies and its restores bill by measured usage. Snapshot storage price not published.

fork.quote: `sandbox.fork({ count })` | `sandbox.fork(count=...)` | Copy a running sandbox 1 to 10 times, memory and processes included.
fork.note: "`sandbox.fork()` returns 409 when a volume is attached and 501 for a sandbox that runs as a pod." Each copy bills like its source.

custom_image.quote: The public CLI does not provide a custom-template upload flow.
custom_image.note: A snapshot is saved "as a private template in its project" (quickstart), so new sandboxes can start from a prepared one.

persistent_disk.quote: Persistent Volumes keep data after a sandbox stops. Each volume mounts at **`/workspace`** and attaches to **one sandbox at a time**.
persistent_disk.note: Volumes use node-local storage; Lizard says to export data you need after a node failure.

desktop.quote: Start the graphical desktop of a sandbox created with `-t desktop` and print its browser URL and a view-only URL.
desktop.note: `--resolution` from 640x480 to 3840x2160; `lizard sandbox vnc` connects a VNC app through a local tunnel.

harness_api.quote: `lizard sandbox prompt <id> <prompt...>` sends a prompt and streams what the agent does.
harness_api.note: Conversations (`-c`, `--new`, `lizard sandbox conversations`) and `lizard sandbox interrupt` for codex, claude, pi, opencode and prime. CLI only: the SDK reference lists no prompt method.

inbound_https.quote: `sandbox.exposePort(port)` | `sandbox.expose_port(port)` | Publish a port; return `url`, `hostname`, and the access token.
inbound_https.note: Every request needs the access token.

eu_data_residency.quote: Regional deployment Launch in US East or EU West. Choose where your agent runs.

persist_scope.quote: Persistent Volumes keep data after a sandbox stops. Each volume mounts at **`/workspace`** and attaches to **one sandbox at a time**.
persist_scope.note: Only /workspace survives a stop; the rest of the filesystem (packages installed elsewhere) resets.

fork_running.quote: `sandbox.fork({ count })` | `sandbox.fork(count=...)` | Copy a running sandbox 1 to 10 times, memory and processes included.
fork_running.note: Not available with a volume attached (409) or for pod sandboxes (501).

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: `fork` copies a running sandbox, memory and processes included; it returns 409 when a volume is attached and 501 for a sandbox that runs as a pod.

desktop_control.quote: The `desktop` template runs a graphical desktop that an agent controls with screenshots, clicks and keys.

computer_use.quote: The `desktop` template runs a graphical desktop that an agent controls with screenshots, clicks and keys.

browser.quote: **Drive a browser.** The `desktop` template runs a graphical desktop that an agent controls with screenshots, clicks and keys.
browser.note: A browser inside the desktop; no CDP/browser-control API documented.

root.quote: `process.exec` accepts `envs`, `workdir`, and `user`; commands run as `root` unless you pass `user`.

secret_proxy.quote: Lizard passes API keys and the stored Claude subscription token unchanged in each run's environment.
secret_proxy.note: Only a ChatGPT login is swapped for a short-lived access token per run; keys reach the sandbox itself.

caveats: Isolation: Firecracker microVMs with their own kernel, except a sandbox that attaches a pod-backed Persistent Volume or restores a pod snapshot, which runs as a Kubernetes pod on runc sharing the host kernel.
`lizard sandbox ssh` is a CLI shell, not the SSH protocol: SSH clients, scp and port forwarding do not work.
Default lifetime is five minutes from the SDK and CLI and no expiration from the raw API and dashboard; it is a deadline from creation, not an idle timer (commands do not reset it).

Fork returns 409 with a volume attached and 501 for a pod sandbox; snapshots do not capture an attached volume. A restore from a pod snapshot is billed by measured usage rather than the size price (not modelled).
Sandbox egress is included up to 2 TB per account over a rolling 30 days; past that nothing is charged, the account's sandboxes lose outbound network until the total falls back under 2 TB.
The $19 Pro monthly credit is shared across the whole platform (apps, databases, storage, egress), not reserved for sandboxes. Overage has no spending cap.
The flat sandbox rates are about a sixth of Lizard's own per-resource rates (CPU $0.025/vCPU-h, memory $0.0125/GB-h).
Self-serve limit is 100 sandboxes at once on Pro (from the first paid invoice; 5 during the trial); more needs Enterprise.
Persistent Volumes are node-local and attach to one sandbox at a time; a sandbox using a volume runs on the volume's node.
Enterprise lists "SOC 2 report (coming soon)"; no HIPAA.
Public usage counter (lizard.build/api/public/stats, 2026-10-01): 436 workspaces, 8,870 sandbox starts in total.

fleet.verification: A card is required to start the 7-day trial; Pro limits apply from the first paid invoice (or a "Start Pro now" payment).
fleet.tiers: Pro trial 5 at once; Pro 100 at once from the first paid invoice; more through Enterprise.
fleet.notes: Start caps: trial 6/min, 30/hour, 100/day; Pro 24/min, 120/hour, 400/day. Limits count per account owner across all workspaces; paused sandboxes do not count, a resume is not a start.
